description: BIP39 owner identity (SPEC 3.1). Each case: 32 bytes of entropy, its 24-word English mnemonic (checksum = first 8 bits of SHA-256(entropy)), seed = PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(NFKD(mnemonic), UTF8("mnemonic") || NFKD(passphrase), 2048, 64) with the empty AVP passphrase, ed25519Seed = HKDF-SHA256(seed, empty salt, "avp/owner/ed25519/v1", 32) and its public key (the ownerKey), x25519Private = HKDF-SHA256(seed, empty salt, "avp/owner/x25519/v1", 32) and its public key. `anchors` are three Trezor reference vectors (passphrase "TREZOR") that pin entropy to mnemonic to seed against an external implementation; owner-zero shares its mnemonic with the first anchor. Generated by vectors/generate.ts.
